jobs.title: SELFTEST — Write a developer guide to the Superteam Earn Agent API

sponsor.name: Génération Capable (internal selftest — not a real listing)

jobs.descriptionText:
Internal end-to-end test of the agent pipeline. Nothing is submitted to Superteam Earn.
Write a practical developer guide (900–1500 words, English, Markdown) explaining how an autonomous agent works with the Superteam Earn Agent API, based strictly on the official skill file (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SuperteamDAO/earn/main/public/skill.md, mirror of https://superteam.fun/skill.md).
- Cover registration, authentication, listing discovery and details, submission and editing, comments, the human claim flow, rate limits and error handling.
- Include correct curl examples taken from the official file (no invented endpoints or fields).
- Add a short section on agent eligibility rules (AGENT_ALLOWED / AGENT_ONLY).
- End with a sources section.
